questions.question: Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.After dinner, all the gang turned out to hunt for turtle eggs on the bar. They went about poking sticks into the sand, and when they found a soft place, they went down on their knees and dug with their hands. Sometimes they would take fifty or sixty eggs out of one hole. They were perfectly round, white things, a trifle smaller than an English walnut. They had a famous fried-egg feast that night, and another on Friday morning. After breakfast they went whooping and prancing out of the bar, and chased each other round and round, shedding clothes as they went, until they were naked, and then continued the frolic far away up the shoal water of the bar, against the stiff current, which later tripped their legs from under them from time to time, and greatly increased the fun. And now and then, they stood in a group and splashed water in each other's faces with their palms, gradually approaching each other with averted faces, to avoid the stagging sprays, and finally gripping and struggling till the best man ducked his neighbour, and then they all went under in a tangle of white legs and arms, and came up blowing, sputtering, laughing, and gasping for breath at one and the same time.What is the main theme of the passage?
options: A scientific study of turtle eggs
A playful hunting trip and water frolic
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (A playful hunting trip and water frolic) है।

questions.question: Comprehension:Read the given passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.The rise of digital technology has transformed the way people communicate, work, and access information. With the advent of the internet, social media platforms, and smartphones, the world has become more connected than ever before. This connectivity offers numerous benefits, such as easier access to knowledge, faster communication, and new opportunities for collaboration across distances. People can now attend virtual conferences, engage in global discussions, and share ideas instantly across time zones. However, the digital age also presents challenges. Excessive screen time can negatively affect mental health, causing issues like anxiety and reduced attention span. Children and adolescents are especially vulnerable to these effects, as their social and cognitive development can be influenced by prolonged digital exposure. Moreover, the spread of misinformation and online privacy concerns are growing problems that require careful attention. Cyberbullying, identity theft, and data breaches further complicate the online experience, raising questions about digital ethics and regulation. Balancing the advantages of digital tools with their potential drawbacks is essential for individuals and societies. In real life, these technological changes impact education, business, and social interactions. For instance, remote work and online learning have become widespread, reshaping traditional methods. These shifts offer flexibility but also demand strong self-discipline and time management skills. As people adapt to these changes, it is crucial to develop digital literacy and responsible online behavior to fully benefit from technology while minimizing its risks. In conclusion, digital technology has revolutionized modern life, but it demands awareness and thoughtful use to ensure positive outcomes.Summarize the passage in one sentence.
options: Social media is the central and only significant aspect of digital technology.
Technology is exclusively responsible for mental health deterioration.
Digital technology has transformed with benefits and challenges requiring balanced use.
The internet is inherently harmful and must be strictly avoided.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Digital technology has transformed with benefits and challenges requiring balanced use.) है।

Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.Critical theory of technology is a political theory of modernity with a normative dimension. It comes from a tradition extending from Marx to Foucault and Habermas which says that advances in the formal claims of human rights take centre stage. Marx attributed this trajectory to the capitalist rationalisation of production. It is prevalent in every modern political system. This trajectory arose from the problems of control over a disempowered and deskilled labour force; but everywhere it is organised — be it Foucault's prisons or Habermas's public sphere — the same pattern prevails. Technological design is shaped by this pattern as the material base of a distinctive social order. In accordance with the notion of thought, critical theory of technology regards technologies as an environment rather than as a collection of tools. We are surrounded by technologies that determine our way of life. The  theory builds an approach on the lessons of these histories. In this respect, they are comparable to laws and customs. These institutions said to represent those who live under their sway through privileging certain dimensions of their human nature. Laws of property represent the interest in ownership. Customs like parental authority represent the interest of childhood in safety and growth. Interests, such as these constitute the version of human nature sanctioned by society. The concept of nature suggests an alternative. The reference here is, of course, not to the nature of natural science, but to the lived nature in which we find ourselves and which we are.Select the statement which supports the opinion of the author.
options: It is not human nature, but human culture that is represented by institutions such as law and custom.
Technologies form the environmental context and shape the contours of human society.
Nature decides the point at which society loses its capacity to control history.
The romantic conception of nature referred to by the passage is the one that requires theoretical legitimacy.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Technologies form the environmental context and shape the contours of human society.) है।

Comprehension:Read the passage and answer the following question: Precipitation in the Mediterranean region is characterised by its uneven distribution throughout the year, with a strong deficit during the warm season. The region is also known for its high spatial and temporal variability in precipitation levels. The substantial year-to-year fluctuations in precipitation are of particular concern due to their significant implications for water resources, a vital asset in the region.The Mediterranean region is subject to the influences of both subtropical circulation and the prevailing sub-polar-frontal low-pressure systems, which exhibit substantial variation in position and intensity over annual and decadal time scales. Anthropogenic forcing is thought to have the potential to disrupt these circulation mechanisms, primarily due to the expansion of the Hadley circulation cell and a northwards shift of the subtropical high-pressure belts. The ultimate consequence could be the prevalence of anticyclonic conditions, accompanied by a reduction in the occurrence of the extratropical storms that typically impact the Mediterranean region. The most conspicuous outcome of these changes could be a decline in precipitation and the increased frequency and severity of meteorological droughts.Indeed, a substantial body of climate change projections anticipates a predominant decrease in precipitation across the Mediterranean region through the twenty-first century. Should this trend be confirmed, it would carry significant implications for both Mediterranean ecosystems and various human activities reliant on water resources. The ramifications include reduced streamflow and water availability, heightened severity of hydrological droughts, elevated forest fire risks, increased plant mortality rates, and decreased crop yields. Considering the conflicting findings presented by some studies on historical precipitation trends in the Mediterranean region, it is crucial to undertake a thorough assessment of long-term precipitation dynamics.Q79. Which of the following titles best encapsulates the key themes and concerns addressed in the passage?
options: Mediterranean Water Resources: Examining Historical Trends and Future Projections
Spatial and Temporal Variability of Precipitation in the Mediterranean Region: Implications for Water Scarcity
Anthropogenic Forcing and Its Role in Shaping Mediterranean Precipitation Patterns
The Impact of Climate Change on Mediterranean Ecosystems and Water Resources
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Spatial and Temporal Variability of Precipitation in the Mediterranean Region: Implications for Water Scarcity) है।

Comprehension:Read the passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.Renewable energy is becoming increasingly vital as we look towards a sustainable future. Unlike fossil fuels, which are finite and contribute significantly to environmental degradation, renewable energy sources such as solar, wind, and hydro power are abundant and environmentally friendly. Solar power harnesses energy from the sun using photovoltaic cells. These cells convert sunlight directly into electricity, providing a clean and inexhaustible power source. Wind energy is captured through wind turbines that generate electricity as they spin, driven by the wind's kinetic energy. Hydropower utilises the energy of flowing water, usually from rivers or dams, to generate electricity.The shift towards renewable energy is crucial for several reasons. First, it helps mitigate climate change by reducing greenhouse gas emissions. Fossil fuels release large amounts of carbon dioxide and other harmful pollutants into the atmosphere, contributing to global warming and health problems. In contrast, renewable energy sources produce little to no emissions during operation. Second, renewable energy promotes energy security by reducing dependence on imported fuels. Countries can harness their natural resources to generate power, leading to greater energy independence and economic stability.Additionally, the renewable energy sector creates numerous jobs in manufacturing, installation, and maintenance. This not only helps in reducing unemployment rates but also fosters economic growth. Technological advancements in renewable energy are also driving down costs, making these sources more competitive with traditional energy sources. Governments and organisations worldwide are recognising the importance of investing in renewable energy and are implementing policies and incentives to accelerate its adoption.In summary, the transition to renewable energy is essential for environmental protection, economic stability, and job creation. By investing in solar, wind, and hydro power, we can ensure a sustainable and prosperous future for generations to come.What is one significant environmental benefit of renewable energy?
options: It gives little to no emissions.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (It gives little to no emissions.) है।

Comprehension:दिए गए गद्यांश के आधार पर पूछे गए प्रश्नों का उत्तर दीजिए। हिन्दी साहित्य का इतिहास हिंदी भाषी जनता की आशाओं-आकांक्षाओं, उसके सुख-दु:ख, उल्लास और निराशा तथा अन्य मनःस्थितियों का शब्द दर्पण है । कहने की आवश्यकता नहीं कि इसका परिचय प्राप्त करना अनेक दृष्टियों से आवश्यक और उपयोगी है । इसीलिए देश के विद्यार्थियों को हिन्दी साहित्य के इतिहास का परिचय शिक्षा के विविध स्तरों पर अनुकूल पद्धति से दिया जाता है । यह काम जितना आवश्यक है उतना ही कठिन, क्योंकि हिन्दी साहित्य के इतिहास के विकास की रेखा सरल और सीधी नहीं है । उसमें जटिलताएँ हैं और मोड़ हैं । हिन्दी साहित्य के लेखन के लिए भाषा ऐसी हो जिसे विद्यार्थी आसानी से समझ सके और उसे विषय की निर्भ्रांत जानकारी हो जाए। इसके साथ ही यह जानकारी ऐसे स्तर की हो कि वह प्रारम्भिक कक्षाओं से लेकर उच्च कक्षाओं की परीक्षाओं में भी अच्छे अंक प्राप्त कर सके । विद्यार्थी को विषय में सीधा प्रवेश मिले, उसे व्यर्थ में इधर-उधर भटकन और उलझना न पड़े । साथ ही, हिन्दी साहित्य के महत्वपूर्ण सूत्रों, कार्य-कारण सम्बन्धों, विभिन्न काल-खंडों की प्रधान और अप्रधान प्रवृत्तियों की सम्यक् जानकारी मिल जाए, जिसके आधार पर वह साहित्य के विभिन्न पहलूओं पर अपनी स्पष्ट अवधारणा प्रस्तुत कर सके ।प्रस्तुत गद्यांश के आधार पर हिन्दी साहित्य के विकास की रेखा सीधी और सरल क्यों नहीं है ?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (उसमें जटिलताएँ और मोड़ हैं) है।

questions.question: Comprehension:निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को पढ़कर प्रश्नों के उत्तर दो।नदियों का पानी पीने …………… तक नहीं बचा है। कभी बेतवा नदी का पानी इतना साफ़ व स्वास्थ्यवर्धक रहता था कि टीबी के मरीज़ भी इस जल का ………….. कर स्वस्थ हो जाते थे। आज बेतवा नदी के किनारे की बस्ती के लोग उसमें …………… डाल रहे हैं। पानी बहुत ……………. हुआ है। यमुना नदी में पुराना यमुना ……………. से लेकर यमुना पुल तक नदियों में शव, गंदगी फेंकी और बहायी जाती है।Q98. रिक्त स्थान (3) के लिए उपयुक्त शब्द कौन-सा है?
वर्तनी की दृष्टि से दिए गए वाक्य के किस अंश में त्रुटि है, पहचानें-- जायसी ने पद्मावती की सुकुमारता का अत्युक्तिपुर्ण वर्णन किया है।1145
'आँचल में गाँठ बाँधना' मुहावरे का अर्थ क्या है?
options: किसी बात को सीख की तरह याद रखना
किसी के साथ रिश्ता जोड़ लेना
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (किसी बात को सीख की तरह याद रखना) है।

निम्न वाक्यांश  के लिए सार्थक शब्द अंकित कीजिए।जो आंखों के सामने हो -

Comprehension:निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और उससे संबंधित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें-मनुष्य नाशवान प्राणी है। वह जन्म लेने के बाद मरता अवश्य है। अन्य लोगों की भाँति महापुरुष भी नाशवान हैं। वे भी समय आने पर अपना शरीर छोड़ देते हैं, पर वे मरकर भी अमर हो जाते हैं। वे अपने पीछे छोड़े गए कार्य के कारण अन्य लोगों द्वारा याद किए जाते हैं। उनके ये कार्य चिरस्थायी होते हैं और समय के साथ-साथ परिणाम और बल में बढ़ते जाते हैं। ऐसे कार्य के पीछे जो उच्च आदर्श होते हैं, वे स्थायी होते हैं और बदली परिस्थितियों में नए वातावरण के अनुसार अपने को ढाल लेते हैं। संसार ने पिछली पच्चीस शताब्दियों से भी अधिक में जितने भी महापुरुषों को जन्म दिया है, उनमें गाँधी जी को यदि आज भी नहीं माना जाता तो भी भविष्य में उन्हें सबसे बड़ा माना जाएगा क्योंकि उन्होंने अपने जीवन की गतिविधियों को विभिन्न भागों में नहीं बाँटा, बल्कि जीवनधारा को सदा एक और अविभाज्य माना। जिन्हें हम सामाजिक, आर्थिक और नैतिक के नाम से पुकारते हैं, वे वास्तव में उसी धारा की उपधाराएँ हैं, उसी भवन के अलग-अलग पहलू हैं। गाँधी जी ने मानव-जीवन के इस नव-कथानक की व्याख्या न किसी हृदय को स्पर्श करने वाले वीरकाव्य की भाँति की और न ही किसी दार्शनिक महाकाव्य की भाँति ही। उन्होंने मनुष्यों की आत्मा में अपने को निम्नतम रूप में उचित कार्य के प्रति निष्ठा, किसी ध्येय की पूर्ति के लिए सेवा और किसी विचार के प्रति स्वार्पण के बीच सतत चलने वाले संघर्ष के नाटक की भाँति माना है।       गाँधी जी को भविष्य में सबसे बड़ा क्यों माना जाएगा?
options: किसी के हृदय को स्पर्श करने से
उन्होंने जीवनधारा को एक और अविभाज्य माना था
विचार के प्रति स्वार्पण का संघर्ष
उचित कार्य के प्रति लगाव न होने से
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (उन्होंने जीवनधारा को एक और अविभाज्य माना था) है।

questions.question: निम्नलिखित वाक्यों में उनके प्रथम तथा अन्तिम अंश संख्या 1 और 6 के अन्तर्गत दिए गए हैं। बीच वाले चार अंश (य), (र), (ल), (व) के अन्तर्गत बिना क्रम के हैं। चारों अंशों को उचित क्रमानुसार व्यवस्थित कर सही विकल्य चुनें।(1) भारतीय गाँवों के-(य) अभी भारत सरकार को(र) सुधार के लिए(ल) और राज्य सरकारों को(व) बहुत प्रयत्न(6) करना होगा।
